message: The other day, I realized my go-bag was feeling a bit neglected, so I decided to give it a little refresh. As I pulled things out, my grandkids came over and started asking questions. Before I knew it, we turned the whole process into a cozy little event, making it a fun family activity. We packed snacks, shared stories, and even drew up a family plan together. It reminded me that preparedness can be more about connection than worry. Have you ever turned a task into a family fun time?
